data.name: Kansei Drift Racing
data.detailed_description:
FEEL THE ROAD. OWN THE CORNER.

Kansei Drift Racing is an anime-inspired open-world racing game built around the art of drifting.

Explore a stylized world influenced by Japanese street racing culture, discover events across the map, challenge rival drivers, and prove your skills behind the wheel.

MASTER THE DRIFT

Control your car through every corner, maintain your angle, connect your drifts, and chase the perfect run. Learning the basics is only the beginning—mastery comes from understanding your car, the road, and the rhythm of every turn.

EXPLORE AN OPEN RACING WORLD

Drive freely through the open world and discover events located across the map. Cruise at your own pace, find new challenges, and choose where your journey takes you next.

MORE THAN DRIFTING

Drifting is at the heart of Kansei Drift Racing, but it is not the only way to compete. Take part in different race modes that test your speed, control, and ability to adapt behind the wheel.

AN ANIME-INSPIRED RACING EXPERIENCE

Toon-shaded visuals and Japanese street racing influences give Kansei Drift Racing its own distinct atmosphere—combining stylish presentation, exciting races, and the thrill of sending a car sideways through every corner.

Find your line. Trust your instincts. Leave your mark on the road.

data.short_description: Kansei Drift Racing is a open-world racing game focused on drifting. Explore stylized Japanese roads, challenge rivals in drift and other race events, and master every corner on your way to becoming a street racing legend.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5-9400F or Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX1660 or Radeon Rx590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 7600 or Intel i7 11700k
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX3060Ti or AMD Radeon RX6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
